scenarios.label: Pick or pass
scenarios.description: Seat 2 holds JS, QD, KS, 10S, 7D, 8D and must PICK or PASS. (This seat goes on to pick.)

scenarios.label: Call a partner
scenarios.description: Seat 2 picked and now holds JS, QD, KS, 10S, 7D, 8D, 8C, 10C (8 cards after the blind). It must choose a partner card — the two-tower CALL scorer is the live head here.

scenarios.label: Bury two cards
scenarios.description: Seat 2 (the picker) holds JS, QD, KS, 10S, 7D, 8D, 8C, 10C and must bury its first card — the pointer head scores every hand slot.

scenarios.label: Lead trick 4
scenarios.description: Seat 2 (the picker) leads trick 4 with 7D, 8D, 8C. The trick is empty; memory carries everything up to this lead.

scenarios.label: Follow late in the hand
scenarios.description: Trick 3: seat 2 (the picker) follows with JS, 7D, 8D, 8C after several cards hit the table. Trick tokens are live and the memory token carries every completed trick.
